description: Ministry of Labour & Trade Union Relations - Appoint persons to be members of the Wages Boards, for the Coconut Growing Trade, Building Trade etc.
categorisation: This gazette exclusively lists the appointments of named individuals (e.g., Mr. K. K. Rathnadasa, Mr. A. S. Sabarathnam) to the Wages Boards for specific trades. It provides only their names and the board they are appointed to, with no detailed description of their portfolio responsibilities or duties. This fits the definition of a People Gazette (Type 2), which covers government personnel changes without detailing their specific functions.
